title: From the lens of early-career researchers: bridging science, technology, arts, and humanities to tackle antimicrobial resistance
core_idea: Describe an initiative that promotes transdisciplinary collaboration across science, engineering, economics, social sciences, arts and humanities, centered on early-career researchers, to develop innovative, context-sensitive approaches to the complex challenge of antimicrobial resistance.
tldr: A perspective proposing a transdisciplinary, early-career-researcher-centered effort to bridge multiple fields and develop context-sensitive strategies to address antimicrobial resistance.
